recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is recommended unless Financial Management opens a new issue to rename the current ClaimResponse.requestor element.
issue_request: FHIR-17928 asked, in STU3 context, to change ClaimResponse.requestProvider to ClaimResponse.provider; the Jira workflow status is Published and the resolution is Persuasive.
initial_application: The broad financial-management application commit afb5ec66f6 explicitly lists FHIR-17928 and changed ClaimResponse requestProvider usage in examples and the spreadsheet to requestor. The follow-up R3/R4 mapping commit d2a25ba3c3 records ClaimResponse.requestProvider=ClaimResponse.requestor.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini includes ClaimResponse as an active resource and retains the requestProvider-to-requestor rename. Current ClaimResponse source, examples, and search parameters use requestor and have no top-level ClaimResponse.provider. Same-family published issues FHIR-17962 and FHIR-17996 explicitly resolved parallel requestProvider rename requests to requestor, the FHIR-37879 reconciliation already on the combined branch relies on ClaimResponse.requestor as the billing-provider element, and current Zulip discussion also states that ClaimResponse.provider does not exist.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because changing current ClaimResponse.requestor to provider would contradict the applied source, same-family Jira resolutions, and current ClaimResponse model.
